Name: Prismatic Paxel
Author: HitaxasTV
Description:
Do you wish you didn't need to swap tools constantly?
Is you hotbar a bit too crowded with tools?

Well, stop wishing, the Prismatic Paxel is here!

The [b]Prismatic [/b][b]Paxel[/b] is a legendary multitool that combines the Axe, Pickaxe, and Hoe into a single prismatic weapon.
One tool for chopping, mining, and tilling, so your inventory (and your sanity) can breathe a little easier.


[b]What it does:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Chops[/b] trees, twigs, and bushes like an axe[/*]
[*][b]Mines[/b] rocks, nodes, boulders, and resource clumps like a pickaxe[/*]
[*][b]Tills and un-tills[/b] dirt, clears weeds, and digs up artifact spots like a hoe[/*]
[*][b]Break machines and chests[/b], like a pickaxe[/*]
[*][b]Attack monsters[/b], like an axe[/*]
[*]Automatically figures out the right tool behavior based on whatever you're swinging at. Just aim and swing[/*]
[*]Charges up just like a vanilla tool, with the tilled/dug area scaling with charge level, all the way up to a sweeping full-charge radius[/*]
[*]Stronger than iridium (max charge area is a whopping 6x8 area)[/*]
[/list][b]How do you get one for yourself?:[/b] Reach level 10 in Farming, Foraging, [i]and[/i] Mining. You will receive a special letter with your reward waiting inside in a few days time

[b]Is it still not powerful enough in your eyes?[/b]: You can enchant it using the volcano forge to get one of 3 enchantments. 
[b]Efficient [/b]- No more stamina drain when using the tool
[b]Swift [/b]- Chop, Mine and till even faster
[b]Fortune [/b]- A brand new, paxel-exclusive enchantment that gives a 50% chance to gain double drops from resource sources. 

Includes built-in support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]EscaMMC's Destroyable Bushes[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]spacechase0's Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
